(3) Fiserv feature inventory — which Architect and Signature features are active vs available but unused? (4) Telephony consolidation — which of the 4 vendors are active vs legacy remnants? MuleSoft connected unlock: MuleSoft is the ROOT CAUSE FIX for the branch-mediated pattern. P1.findings_md: P1 is scored from 186 capability across 5 categories. this area reveals a bank that governs compliance exceptionally (: 2.88) but treats technology as a cost center rather than a strategic capability. The Research Report Insight Cards for -C5 identified this as an 'implicit strategy' model — Fiserv IS the strategy.
P1.heading: 4.1 Pillar 1: Digital Strategy & Leadership (2.03, M2 Developing)

P2.findings_md: P2 is the heaviest-weighted pillar (30%) and TrustCo's weakest overall. 232 capability scored reveal a bank where digital tools exist (Fiserv Architect, Tealium CDP, ClickSWITCH, Credit Sense) but NONE operate independently of branch staff. The Research Report's central pattern — 'branch-mediated digital model' — is most visible in P2.
P2.heading: 4.2 Pillar 2: Customer Experience (1.42, M1 Foundational)

P3.findings_md: P3 contains TrustCo's defining paradox and its most actionable discovery. 118 capability reveal a bank where compliance (: 3.38) operates at level 3+ Established — the ONLY category above level 3 in the entire assessment — while operational automation (: 1.42) is absent. The Research Report's 'Efficiency Paradox' is the core P3 finding: best-in-class efficiency ratio built on lean staffing, not technology. This model is fragile.
P3.heading: 4.3 Pillar 3: Operations, Risk & Compliance (2.14, M2 Developing)

P4.findings_md: P4 is the ROOT CAUSE pillar. 172 capability reveal that TrustCo's digital challenges across P1-P3 trace back to fundamental technology architecture gaps. The Research Report identified this as the root cause of the 'branch-mediated pattern' — without integration (: 1.41), digital tools cannot operate independently. Without data governance (: 1.14), personalization is impossible. Without analytics (: 1.11), the bank cannot measure what matters.
P4.heading: 4.4 Pillar 4: Data, Analytics & Technology (1.52, M2 Developing)
